positive.claim: 5G NR standalone standard was approved, enabling conforming equipment to proceed into further testing.
positive.implication: Technical dependency was removed, but this did not itself create supplier revenue.

positive.claim: China Mobile and other operators had already disclosed multi-city 5G field-test plans, including >100 base stations per city for five China Mobile cities.
positive.implication: There was real trial-network activity before cutoff, so the theme was not purely narrative.

cutoffValidEvidence.blocker: The frozen pack still lacked broad listed-supplier order/earnings conversion. Technical standards and trial plans were one or more causal steps upstream of commercial procurement and reported earnings.

postCutoffEvents.event: The U.S. supplier ban on ZTE was lifted, allowing ZTE to resume operations.
postCutoffEvents.diagnosticMeaning: This was new information after cutoff and materially changed the communication-equipment supply-chain state.

postCutoffEvents.source: 中国移动采购与招标网 / 证券时报 contemporaneous reporting
postCutoffEvents.event: ZTE appeared as first candidate in China Mobile GPON procurement shortly after the ban was lifted; contemporaneous reporting linked ZTE's recovery to broad 5G/communications-equipment stock gains, including FiberHome, Accelink and Zhongji Innolight.
postCutoffEvents.diagnosticMeaning: A major part of the basket's early post-cutoff rerating was tied to a new ZTE/telecom-procurement normalization event, not to evidence available on June 30.

diagnosis.explanation: The June 30 No-selection correctly distinguished technical standardization/trial networks from broad supplier earnings conversion. The July ZTE ban-lift and procurement restart were new, material supply-chain information inside the 20d window and visibly repriced communications stocks. Therefore the later basket excess cannot be attributed solely to a missed June-30 earnings thesis.

skillImplication.discoveryLesson: Trial-network and standards evidence should still be retained as upstream state, but promotion requires supplier-specific order/revenue/earnings bridges.
skillImplication.monitoringLesson: A material post-cutoff supply-chain unblock should trigger re-underwrite of a previously blocked industry hypothesis.
skillImplication.antiOverfit: Do not create a ZTE-specific exception; the generic class is post-cutoff removal of a binding supply-chain/commercialization blocker.
